user.title: Add a calendar share
user.description: Choose the calendar to expose as an unauthenticated iCalendar (.ics) subscription feed.

confirm.title: Share URL created
confirm.description:
Copy this URL and add it as a calendar subscription in your calendar app. You can find it again later in the integration's options.

`{url}`

**Anyone with this URL can read this calendar's events.** Only use HTTPS, never share it over an unencrypted connection.

init.title: Calendar share options
init.description:
Current share URL (keep it private):

`{url}`

When "Full calendar" is on, the whole calendar is shared and the day counts below are ignored.

data.full_calendar: Full calendar (ignore the day counts below, share everything)
data.days_ahead: Days ahead to include in the feed
data.days_behind: Days in the past to include in the feed
data.regenerate_token: Regenerate the share token (invalidates the current URL immediately)
